method: Follow AWOIAF template fields/categories for article architecture; store temporal facts and relationships separately.

house.status: verified parameter names from source documentation

valueNotes.lord_lady: Choose current or last historical holder only after date resolution.
valueNotes.seat: Defaults to 'of' in original MediaWiki template; separate place entity in Orryn model.
valueNotes.arms_blazon: Graphic and verbal heraldry are distinct; image rights checked independently.
valueNotes.founded_extinct: Date or period must be supported; no backward or forward inference.
valueNotes.cadet1_cadet2: A later-created branch cannot be included in a 208 AC snapshot.

person.status: partial documented mapping; verify complete module before bulk character import

place.status: category-based example; location/settlement templates require separate verification

event.status: sample battle infobox; complete conflict schema requires separate verification

rules: A house, physical seat, hereditary office, and current holder are four distinct entities.
Category membership does not prove family or vassal relationship.
No unplayed future event is imported as established history.
Null house words means unestablished; never invent words or affiliations.
Source identifiers identify evidence; wiki text remains separate from editorial documentation.
status: Exploratory mapping, not a completed reverse-engineering of all MediaWiki templates.
importRules: Preserve house and seat as different records.
Always bind a current head, heir, and overlord to a dated fact, not a static imported value.
Keep sources and article licensing provenance attached to individual fields or facts.
Do not assume that a published 300 AC cadet branch exists in 208 AC.
Do not publish unknown names, dates, genealogies, words, or the Worldbook's speculative future scenario notes.
Worldbook's rank fields are user-continuity categories, not AWOIAF infobox parameters.
Do not bulk copy AWOIAF prose or images without license-specific attribution and reproduction review.
